title: cassia javanica subsp. microcalyx
intro: Cassia javanica subsp. microcalyx, commonly known as Javanese senna, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation due to its laxative effects. The health benefits of Javanese senna include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Javanese senna are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin, which may also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
